spec.title: Your chat history is an illusion
spec.summary: Chatbots do not remember past messages and instead re-read the whole transcript every time you speak.
sources: provider api documentation on conversation messages
provider pricing page for input tokens

beats.say: Your chatbot does not remember anything you tell it.
Every new message mails the entire past chat back to the server.
Turn two sends the first line plus the second line.
Turn three adds all previous lines again.
Ten turns repeat fifty five total lines.
You pay for the same text ten times over.
